independent_checks.code_review: Only local assembly and CreateNew outputs. Exact subject pinned; accepted scope/purpose/Audience/algorithm/SQL inputs and Owner window checked. New report must bind separate actual merge/parents/tree/payload/ref hashes. No network, DB, signature issuance or implicit registration.

trusted_input_boundary: Report bytes and SHA must come from actual independent GitHub verification, not caller-chosen synthetic evidence. Checking VERIFIED/verified booleans locally is not cryptographic verification.
The actual main merge must sign the exact payload and expose matching accepted decision and source blobs. Prior PR25 signature is not reusable for the new payload.
Publish and independently read back the actual verification report on the accepted fixed private evidence branch before using its blob URI. Local Git blob identity is not a durability receipt.
RootSet.json and AcceptedBinding.json are only local assembly inputs. Fresh Owner/root-prefix checks and the exact atomic configuration plus first-event transaction remain required.
Use only new output directories in the approved workspace; do not use file assembly to overwrite original source or bypass actual source verification.
